visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of article or adventure teasers linking to detail pages
visualCharacteristics.description: Heading with short yellow underline; 4 article cards (image, uppercase title, one-line truncated grey description); yellow 'All Articles' button; ends with hr separator. | h3 'Where do you want to go?'; 4 adventure cards (image, uppercase title, truncated description) same look as Recent Articles; yellow 'All Trips' button; ends with hr separator.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 image; cell 2 linked title and a short description

usage: Lists of recent articles, adventures or similar linked teasers (typically 4 per row).
reuseGuidance: Use for any image + linked title + one-line description list. Section heading and "All ..." button stay as default content around the block.
